title: On the Trinity
author: Epiphanius of Salamis
blurb: A passionate defense of the Christian Trinity from a 4th-century bishop, exploring how God's three persons are one in glory and worship.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Epiphanius of Salamis’s De trinitate — new OET from PG 41–43 Greek (Khazarzar). Modern English syncs (incl. Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill) were not used as wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew densify. SERIES CLOSEOUT.
